text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you looking so sleepy.
It's rare to see you looking so sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's right...
Actually, last night, Gold Ship-san――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, if you pray to God under the legendary tree at midnight, you lose a ton of weight! Let's go find it!"
...is what they barged in saying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It wasn't that I truly believed it, but I followed along hoping there might be even the slightest chance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And yet that person said, "I'm bored,"
and went home halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... If she ever invites me again...
I think I shall decline next time...

Staying up late must have really taken its toll,
as Mejiro McQueen let out a huge yawn.
